source_data: Freenove FNK0052 original CAD30 nominal mesh model; mesh data/actual hardware excluded from this public report
uncertainties: 2D footprints and COM targets are virtual and do not establish achievable 6-to-4 preparation
3D screen uses a bounded local numerical IK solver with fixed body orientation/height and a prescribed interpolation, not full nonlinear contact-implicit optimization
Failures within the tested solver settings are not mathematical certificates of infeasibility; alternative paths/orientations/heights/order/footprints may exist
Static LP tests nominated contact forces and is not a dynamic gait proof
No complete G1 accepted candidate. G2 dynamic MuJoCo period rollout intentionally NOT RUN
decision: No local foot-by-foot controller search; perform a jointly constrained periodic trajectory optimization or report bounded search, keeping G1 separate from G2
